body.name: Тридцатипятилетние. Алмаз. Настя
body.summary: Since 1989, the authors have been tracking the lives of twenty children from various republics of the former Soviet Union, revisiting their stories every seven years. This time, the focus is on 35-year-olds.

show.name: Рожденные в СССР
show.summary: The documentary series "Born in the USSR" is a unique cinematic chronicle that began in 1989 and has been running for more than thirty years. The series' creators follow the lives of twenty children from different republics of the former Soviet Union, revisiting their stories every seven years. Today, the protagonists have grown up, and we see how their dreams, personalities, and outlooks on life have changed, and how they navigate the pivotal moments of their own coming of age and the maturation of the society around them.

show.name: Невский
show.summary: Since time immemorial, dark forces have been flattering themselves with the hope of conquering our beautiful planet. But every time they are opposed by heroes who stand up to defend their Motherland. Just such a hero lives in St. Petersburg. He is the most powerful and strong. He is so old that he himself has forgotten his name, so everyone simply calls him Nevsky. Once upon a time, it was he and several other heroes who stopped the countless armies of Pestilence, the conqueror of worlds. But the evil did not disappear, but hid in order to accumulate strength for a new invasion.

show.name: Искусство падения
show.summary: Dima, a young dancer, participates in a choreographic show and falls under the influence of a strict mentor, Phil. Together with his girlfriend, he becomes a participant in a psychological experiment that Phil puts on all the wards, testing them for their willingness to become real artists. But the dance show doesn't just change them. Renata is a tough and uncompromising producer who sees dancing exclusively as a business. However, her worldview is crumbling under the influence of the powerful energy of the young dancer Anton. As a result, dancing penetrates deeply into the lives of the characters, making them move in every sense of the word.

show.name: История его служанки
show.summary:
Moscow, 19th century. Lush balls, the glamour of estates, and behind-the-scenes intrigues. The young and eligible bachelor Count Nikolai Sheremetyev returns to the world of high society after the war. His arrival ignites the social circles, as mothers and daughters plot to secure a wealthy husband. However, things become more complicated for Nikolai, as his mother's will requires him to marry within a year, or he will lose his inheritance. Meanwhile, the Averin family finds themselves on the brink of ruin due to the family's gambling debts. Their daughter, Anna, a stubborn and witty noblewoman, decides to meet the count personally, hoping he will forgive their debt.

 Sheremetyev, a man of principles, offers a deal: a year of Anna's service at his estate. Thus, Anna becomes the count's most unusual servant. As she adjusts to her new role, various suitors arrive at Nikolai's home. However, the more time they spend together, the more difficult it becomes to conceal their mutual attraction. In the meantime, the stories unfold between Anna's younger brother, Roma, and the daughter of wealthy neighbors, Yulia, as well as between Elena and Averin, a couple whose marriage teeters on the brink of collapse but still holds a flickering spark.

show.name: Манюня
show.summary: In the late 1970s, in a small provincial town, girls Manyunya and Narine live a joyful and adventurous life. Their everyday life is filled with pranks, friendship, the first childhood worries, and amusing misunderstandings that invariably involve adults: the strict but kind Granny, dad Misha, and Narine's parents, Nadya and Yura. Narine's younger sister, Karinka the "meteor," and her eternal "victim," Rubik, join the gang, making the stories even more unpredictable. From trying to tame a kitten and fix a car to playing "adults" and staging their own theatrical productions, the girls learn friendship, mutual support, and responsibility. Their pranks often turn into funny and sometimes even instructive lessons, but most importantly, Manyunya and Narine always stay together, turning their childhood into a true fairy tale.

show.name: Красота
show.summary: The end of the 80s, a time of change and high hopes. Vera, the director of the House of Culture, launches the country's first beauty contest, despite the displeasure of officials. But against the background of the collapse of the country, it is under threat of closure — the country has no money for beauty. In an attempt to find a solution, Vera makes a deal with criminals, falling into a dangerous trap.

show.name: Балтийское море
show.summary: Chapter Three of the war drama starring Pavel Trubiner and Ekaterina Vilkova. Summer 1944. A Soviet naval hunter manages to sink the German submarine U‑250 in the Baltic Sea. On board the vessel, they find advanced acoustic torpedoes that can change the balance of power not only in the Baltic Sea but throughout the entire Atlantic. In Leningrad and Kronstadt, a group of enemy saboteurs, led by the German resident Faust, begins a secret operation. The opponents are plotting to destroy the torpedoes and the Soviet design bureau responsible for developing anti‑torpedo defense systems. Lieutenant Colonel Sergei Saburov and Major Elena Solei stand in the way of the invaders; they must uncover and neutralize the enemy while simultaneously identifying the traitor in their closest circle. While carrying out this extremely important mission, the heroes will also try to preserve their love, which will face a serious test of its strength.

show.name: Against the Sky Supreme
show.summary: The former mighty Gods of the heavens, after ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation tragically destroyed! The cruel curse, the hatred of ten thousand lives, Tan Yun determined, no longer sink! The most important thing is that you have to be able to get to the top of the world, step by step, stepping on the corpses of your enemies! To kill against the sky, across all the worlds, only I am the supreme!

show.name: Cang Yuan Tu
show.summary: The story tells the story of Meng Chuan, the protagonist, who has made a vow to avenge his mother's death since he was a child and takes the Mirror Lake Daoist College as his starting point. With his resolute and fearless heart and decisive sword skills, he punishes the evil, destroys the demons, ascends to the top of the four Daoist Colleges, becomes famous in the Dongning Province, pays homage to the Yuanchu Mountain, and achieves a generation of gods and demons.(DeepL)

show.name: The Sound of Sugar Cubes
show.summary: An orphan, Han Yul didn't have much in life but a dream to become a singer. That is, till he saw his best friend mercilessly murdered by someone he looked up to. Harold. Popular. Perfect. Psychopath. And rich enough to cover his tracks. On the run, Han Yul quits high school, changing his name with every new job he scrambles together. When a famous singer hears his voice and offers a chance at revenge, one question remains: can he sing?

show.name: Small Town Remedy
show.summary: This series tells the story of Liu Zhengliang (Played by Xiao Zhan), a genius doctor who suffers a major life setback and is forced to return to his hometown to start over. He gathers a group of seemingly "unreliable" people, and they passionately commit to doing the most reliable, meaningful things. Surrounded by the cozy, bustling neighborhood vibe, they weave warm daily moments with human kindness, offering life prescriptions that heal people's souls.

show.name: The Lament of Autumn
show.summary: In the turbulent 1920s, Yu Changxuan and Ye Pingjun fall into a love-hate entanglement, defying war and fate together.

show.name: Where the Mask Ends
show.summary: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

show.name: When the Lights Rise
show.summary: Shanghai, 1936. Mei Yuhe, a seamstress who works for the wealthy elite, takes matters into her own hands after her younger sister's mysterious death, personally dissecting the body. Together with Ding Zhao, a loan shark, she pieces together the scandalous secrets of high society, exposing the sordid sexual networks hidden beneath the neon lights.

show.name: My Loong
show.summary: Yue Wangshu, the daughter of a military family, is offered as a sacrifice to the Dragon Abyss. There, she accidentally releases the Dragon Lord Li Zhi. From hostility to mutual understanding, they form an alliance based on a bargain to suppress the Li Fire. She uses the Dragon Lord's power to fight back against the plots of the Yue family and Prince Qi, while he learns human love through her. Ultimately, Li Zhi chooses to remain in the human world, and the two create an epic romance.

show.name: Bionic Trace
show.summary: In 2035, Song Yang, a top student specializing in AI, is falsely accused of murdering his girlfriend and her daughter. While on the run, he teams up with Ada, an android who has developed self-awareness. Together, they solve a series of mysterious cases and uncover the dark secrets of Cedar Group. Eventually, the truth is revealed, and Song Yang clears his name. Ada sacrifices herself to protect him, and humans and androids enter a new era of coexistence.

show.name: Overseas Security Guard
show.summary: Set against the Belt and Road backdrop, this drama focuses on a real-world story of overseas private security. Wei Tian, a man with top-level protective skills, loses his wife and daughter in a terrorist attack. He assumes a hidden identity in Antilocaris and forms a private security squad called "The Silent Ones" to protect Chinese compatriots living abroad.

show.summary: Dumped for money by childhood sweetheart Gu Zheng, adopted daughter Lin Hua takes best friend Xie Bao'er's advice and enters a contract marriage with Bao'er's father, Xie Zhouhan. He quietly protects her. She learns her mother once cared for him in his youth, and he has loved Lin Hua for years. She lets go of her past and opens her heart. They tear up their contract and choose a lifetime of love.

body.name: Skijoring
body.summary: Vegard Ylvisåker and Nicolay head to the Rocky Mountains in the USA to compete in a wild slalom contest behind a galloping horse.

show.name: Helt Ramme sporter
show.summary: From acrobatic football-volleyball in Malaysia to the World Championship in eating fries in Canada. Nicolay Ramm brings four of Norways bravest celebs out in the world. Here they will try to become the best in some of the worlds weridest sports.

body.name: Muldvarpen
body.summary: How do you build an alliance with a competitor, or perhaps even several alliances simultaneously? In such cases, it can be very useful to work with a mole.

show.name: Bløff
show.summary: In a fairytale castle, ten contestants compete against each other in a game that isn't about how smart you are, but about how smart people think you are.

show.name: Tigers Sniff the Rose
show.summary: Defying the fate laid out for her, Princess Mu Wanyao joins forces with Yan Shang, a young man of humble origins with an unrivaled gift for strategy, to forge a realm of peace and prosperity. With larger-than-life characters, thrilling twists, and exhilarating triumphs, the story follows a generation of young idealists who rise amid the storms of a troubled age, determined to shape the world around them and pursue their dreams.

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: Breitscheidplatz 19/12
show.summary: About a week before Christmas 2016, a truck plowed into the popular holiday market at Breitscheidplatz, a crowded public square. Twelve people died and many were injured in Germany's deadliest terror attack in decades.

show.summary: The hit global drag phenomenon is now in the Philippines! Watch as 12 iconic queens slay and race to the finish line and compete to be the first ever Drag Race Superstar from the Philippines. It's the Filipinos' time to shine, henny... and you ain't seen nothing yet!

body.name: Cease & Desist
body.summary: Dwight rallies the troops to fight back as Governor Clark shuts down his businesses, freezes bourbon shipments, and targets his crew.

show.name: Tulsa King
show.summary: Tulsa King follows New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi, just after he is released from prison after 25 years and unceremoniously exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a "crew" from a group of unlikely characters, to help him establish a new criminal empire in a place that, to him, might as well be another planet.

body.name: No Quiet Life
body.summary: Season finale. A high-stakes gambit leads to unintended consequences.

show.name: Dark Matter
show.summary: Hailed as one of the best sci-fi novels of the decade, Dark Matter is a story about the road not taken. The series follows Jason Dessen, a physicist, professor, and family man who – one night while walking home on the streets of Chicago – is abducted into an alternate version of his life. Wonder quickly turns to nightmare when he tries to return to his reality amid the multiverse of lives he could have lived. In this labyrinth of mind-bending realities, he embarks on a harrowing journey to get back to his true family and save them from the most terrifying, unbeatable foe imaginable: himself.

show.name: Nocturne
show.summary: Nocturne tells the story of Jonah Lynn, an ex-soldier turned homicide detective who, tired of working the tough streets of Philadelphia, moves to a small town in Western Pennsylvania for a quiet life. But, as the town and his family come under attack from the diabolically cunning serial killer Jurek Walter, Jonah must protect all that he holds dear. When the desperate search for Jurek's last missing victim forces Jonah to send his adopted daughter, FBI Agent Saga Bauer, up against Jurek, how far will Jonah go?

show.name: The Great Ruler
show.summary: In the vast world, planes converge and numerous races thrive. A gathering of extraordinary talents unfolds, where one after another, supreme beings from the lower planes come forth. In this boundless realm, they weave captivating legends that inspire admiration, pursuing the path to dominance.

body.name: Ace of Spades
body.summary: The Harrigans lock down the Cotswolds and roll back into London to shake the tree – buying loyalty with cash, threats, and broken fingers. Maeve tightens the screws within the family, while Harry walks into a trap.

show.name: MobLand
show.summary:
With the most powerful clients in Europe, MobLand will see family fortunes and reputations at risk, odd alliances unfold, and betrayal around every corner; and while the family might be London's most elite fixers today, the nature of their business means there is no guarantee what's in store tomorrow.

MobLand follows two generations of gangsters, the businesses they run, the complex relationships they weave and the man they call upon to fix their problem.

show.name: Smartypants
show.summary: The greatest thinkers/comedians of our time ask the questions no one else will.

show.name: Amanpour
show.summary: Amanpour is CNN International's flagship global affairs interview program hosted by Chief International Correspondent Christiane Amanpour.

show.name: LOL: Last One Laughing Philippines
show.summary: "LOL" or "Last One Laughing" is a reality show where ten comedians battle it out to make each other laugh. With no smiles allowed, they unleash their best jokes and antics, aiming to make each other crack up for six hours. It's a hilarious battle of wit and self-control, where the last one laughing wins ONE MILLION PESOS!

previousepisode.name: The first-ever grand champion of LOL Philippines

body.name: Risky Business
body.summary: Dexter struggles to find purpose beyond the hunt as Harrison begins his NYPD career. A brazen new murderer puts the city on edge.

show.name: Dexter: Resurrection
show.summary: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

show.name: Avatar: Seven Havens
show.summary: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

show.name: Dead-End Job
show.summary: Dead-End Job follows, a young man who takes on a seemingly perfect part-time job offering 50 times the usual hourly wage through a mysterious employment agency called Spyder Human Resource Center. However, the job quickly becomes a nightmare as he encounters strange and terrifying phenomena.

show.name: Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars
show.summary: Experience thrilling highs and crushing lows as the world's best chefs pursue the ultimate accolade: a Michelin Star. These anonymous inspectors have never let anyone in on their mysterious ways, until now.

previousepisode.name: "Michelin is like the girlfriend you can never get"

show.name: Furia
show.summary: A contemporary portrait around five women ready to do anything in the face of extreme situations such as extortion, oppression, deceit, exclusion or manipulation in a single shared universe articulated around five conflicts that will develop like a butterfly effect – one as a consequence of the other – and so on to shared catharsis.

show.name: American Pulse
show.summary: American Pulse is an hour showcasing reporting from the vast network of CNN affiliates across the country.

show.name: The Football Interview
show.summary: The biggest names in sport and entertainment join host Kelly Somers for bold, in-depth conversations about the nation's favourite sport.

show.name: 4 Blocks Zero
show.summary: The prequel to the award-winning gangster drama ‘4 Blocks' tells the story of the Hamadys in 1990s Berlin: having fled Lebanon and only accepted as tolerated refugees in Germany, they struggle to gain a foothold in their new home. Who are they, how did the family become the most influential clan in the city, and how did Ali eventually become Toni?

show.name: Oops! Mysterious Sounds
show.summary: A second-hand pair of earphones connects two rivals to the world of the dead. When their idol friend dies under mysterious circumstances, what starts as enemies forced to "fake date" turns into an undeniable bond as they become reluctant partners in a murder investigation. Before the killer... silences them as the next victims. The deeper they dig, the closer they get to death-and to each other. Until they can no longer tell which one is louder: the "voice of the dead" or the "sound of their racing hearts".

show.name: Mystery Forest
show.summary: Sixteen years ago, on Lunar New Year's Eve, a devastating explosion tore through Zhao Zhiguo's lumber mill in Xinchun, destroying the Zhao family. His son, Zhao Long, miraculously survived but vanished without a trace. Sixteen years later, Zhao Long returns to his hometown under the alias Wang Hong. Using the purchase of Korean pine timber as a cover, he sets out to uncover the truth behind his family's tragedy. Meanwhile, tensions run high in Xinchun as a logging ban on Korean pine disrupts the timber industry, fueling conflicts among powerful businessmen, including Teng Laohu and his son, and Lin Shengli. When a series of murders shakes the town, criminal investigator Cao Jin is assigned to the cases. As Wang Hong navigates mounting dangers, he searches for old Korean pine timber bearing a distinctive paint marking, a crucial clue to the tragedy sixteen years earlier. Along the way, he meets Li Xuefei, a young woman searching for her missing mother, and the two join forces. As their investigation deepens, long-buried clues begin to surface, connecting a string of murders to an intricate timber-smuggling operation. One by one, hidden secrets are exposed, bringing the true culprit into the light. After surviving countless dangers and finally uncovering the truth, Wang Hong makes peace with his painful past and leaves Xinchun behind, ready to begin a new chapter of his life.

show.summary: Sixteen years ago, on Lunar New Year's Eve, a devastating explosion tore through Zhao Zhiguo's lumber mill in Xinchun, destroying the Zhao family. His son, Zhao Long, miraculously survived but vanished without a trace. Sixteen years later, Zhao Long returns to his hometown under the alias Wang Hong. Using the purchase of Korean pine timber as a cover, he sets out to uncover the truth behind his family's tragedy. Meanwhile, tensions run high in Xinchun as a logging ban on Korean pine disrupts the timber industry, fueling conflicts among powerful businessmen, including Teng Laohu and his son, and Lin Shengli. When a series of murders shakes the town, criminal investigator Cao Jin is assigned to the cases. As Wang Hong navigates mounting dangers, he searches for old Korean pine timber bearing a distinctive paint marking, a crucial clue to the tragedy sixteen years earlier. Along the way, he meets Li Xuefei, a young woman searching for her missing mother, and the two join forces. As their investigation deepens, long-buried clues begin to surface, connecting a string of murders to an intricate timber-smuggling operation. One by one, hidden secrets are exposed, bringing the true culprit into the light. After surviving countless dangers and finally uncovering the truth, Wang Hong makes peace with his painful past and leaves Xinchun behind, ready to begin a new chapter of his life.

The rules are simple: laugh and you're out, scream and you're out. Who will survive Last One Laughing: Halloween?

show.summary: The game has crossed into reality, and the old rules no longer apply. Humanity enters an age where anyone can awaken a class, but the opportunity draws unwanted attention: demons from the abyss and the dragonkin both want this new world, and neither is willing to share it. Lin Moyu wakes up in this world with the one class no one else has: Necromancer. His talent is unmatched, his ability system unlike anything else in play, and he grows stronger with every fight, building an army out of the dead until he no longer needs anyone else at his side. As the Shenxia Empire's last line of defense against the abyssal invasion, he becomes the one man capable of breaking the deadlock between humans, demons, and dragons, and the one who ends up standing above all three.

show.name: Mystery Science Theater 3000
show.summary:
Mystery Science Theater 3000 started as a locally produced television show for KTMA in Minnesota but soon grew in popularity. It moved to Comedy Central (originally the Comedy Channel), then to Syfy. After an eighteen-year hiatus, the crew of the Satellite of Love returned in 2017, airing on Netflix for two seasons. In 2021, the production started its own streaming service, The Gizmoplex, where the riffing of cheesy movies continues. Rifftrax revitalised the series once again in 2026 with four more episodes of the series. 

Over the years, there have been several "test subjects": Joel Robinson, Mike Nelson, Jonah Heston, and Emily Connor along with their robot friends Tom Servo, Crow T Robot, and Gypsy (now GPC) all subjected to bad movies thanks to a host of mad scientists including Doctor Clayton Forrester, his mother Pearl, and most recently Kinga Forrester.
